charge_port.notes: Estimated: CCS1 (J1772 native inlet) through the 2026 model year: press pages for this model line state CCS1 for 2024-2026 and NACS from 2027. Same port assumed for the Canadian car (Guide Auto 2024-09-18: Canadian owners need the GM adapter). Model year 2025.

supercharger_access.notes: US page: CCS1 cars use Superchargers with the GM-approved NACS adapter ($299) / optional adapter in GM's spec guide. Current state for model year 2025: adapter needed. Markets: CA/US.

ac_max_kw.notes: NRCan lists this car as "(11.5 kW Charger)" with a matching 240 V charge time. Standard charger; the 19.2 kW version is a separate option.

wheels.notes: Cars.com details only the Luxury w/1SC trim (20 in, 265/50R20); other 2025 trims and options not confirmed. AWD trim not shown on the Cars.com page: AWD wheel size unconfirmed, assumed equal to the detailed trim.

ac_max_kw.notes: NRCan lists this car as "(19.2 kW Charger)" with a matching 240 V charge time.
